Oxford College Woodruff Scholars receive merit scholarships, early faculty mentorship, and a tight-knit community with smooth transition to Atlanta campus. Scholars may apply for funding to support unpaid domestic or international internships, research project expenses, and qualifying conference travel.
departments: Emory College of Arts and Sciences
Nell Hodgson Woodruff School of Nursing

academic_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Woodruff Scholars: partial to full merit; Deadline ED I Nov 1, ED II/Reg Nov 15; Answer 'Yes' to Scholar question; ~10k applicants, 175-200 finalists; Renewable 8 semesters; Intl eligible; Supplemental funding for internships/research/abroad
